baseballNotes: Research notes (Aug 2026): most deadlines below are current-page dates but only 7 of 25 schools' pages explicitly confirmed "2026-27"/"Fall 2027" — double check the ones flagged "unconfirmed" before treating as final. Coach emails for Bucknell, FSU, Sacred Heart, UD, and Richmond came from search-index results, not a direct page fetch — verify before emailing. Tulane's coach has no email/phone listed publicly. Fairfield has a new head coach (Brian Fay, replacing retired Bill Currier). FSU and UF both added a new binding Early Decision option this cycle (Oct 15) — verify details directly with admissions. Princeton's coach (Ryan Forrest) was just named in July 2026, so only the program office contact is available yet. Pitt added Aug 2026: coach names come from the Sept 2025 staff-announcement release (staff page is JS-rendered and lists no emails/phones), so all five contacts need verifying before outreach. Saint Joseph's added Aug 2026: coach emails/phones were read off the live staff page so they are verified, but Lee Saverio has no contact listed and the hitting/pitching designations come from press releases rather than the staff page. Team X/Twitter handles filled in Aug 2026 from search-index results that returned the live x.com profile URL; they were not opened and confirmed one by one, so spot-check before following or DMing. Two caveats: Case Western has TWO accounts (@cwru_baseball and @CWRUbaseball) and it is unclear which is current; Trinity was disambiguated as @TrinBaseball ("Bantam Baseball", the Hartford mascot) because @TrinityBaseball appears to belong to Trinity University in Texas. Division/conference/demonstratedInterest research (Sept 2026): NCAA division and conference are cross-confirmed via multiple search sources for all 24 schools. Roster sizes are best-effort from search snippets (news previews, "returners + newcomers" totals, or third-party aggregators) since official roster pages were not directly fetchable this session — verified/solid counts: FSU (38, from official roster PDF position breakdown), Hofstra (35), Delaware (38), Florida (41), Pitt (40), Villanova (33); softer estimates: Babson (~43), Skidmore (~34, from a season-preview article), Richmond (37, third-party aggregator, not the official page); left null (no reliable count found) for Bucknell, Case Western, Holy Cross, Dickinson, Fairfield, Lafayette, Princeton, Sacred Heart, Saint Joseph's, Stevens, Trinity, Tulane, Union, WPI, Yale — spot-check official roster pages before relying on these. demonstratedInterest (true/false, from each school's Common Data Set section C7 'Level of applicant's interest' where available) has a demonstratedInterestConfidence field per school ('high' = directly corroborated CDS wording or an explicit admissions-office statement, e.g. FSU/Princeton/Richmond/Villanova/Yale all explicitly say interest is NOT considered, contrary to typical assumptions; 'low' = inferred from general admissions commentary rather than a confirmed CDS line — Holy Cross, Hofstra, Saint Joseph's, Stevens fall here and should be verified directly against each school's CDS PDF before treating as certain). Open house research (Sept 2026): openHouseDates/openHouseDatesConfidence added per school, sourced from WebSearch snippets of each school's admissions visit page (direct page fetches were blocked by this environment's network egress policy, so treat 'low'/'medium' confidence entries as needing a manual confirm against the source page before relying on them for scheduling). Several schools genuinely run no single dated open house and instead offer rolling daily tours/info sessions — Babson, Fairfield (main campus), FSU, Princeton, Tulane, Florida, and Yale all fall into this category, which is a real finding rather than a research gap. Best-confidence specific dates: Bucknell (Sept 12/Oct 3/Oct 24), Holy Cross (Nov 8), Dickinson (Sept 19/Oct 3/Oct 12/Nov 1), Lafayette (Oct 17/Nov 5-6), Sacred Heart (Oct 18/Nov 14), Stevens (Oct 5/Nov 9), Trinity (Oct 10/15), Union (Oct 12), Delaware (Nov 7), Villanova (Sept 12-13). Needs follow-up closer to the season (school hasn't posted a 2026 date yet): Case Western, Hofstra, Saint Joseph's, Skidmore, Pitt, Richmond, WPI.
